text: For dependent functions f, g: Π(x:A). B(x), a homotopy h: f ~ g is:
choices: a path f = g in Π(x:A). B(x)
a term of type Π(x:A). f(x) = g(x)
an equivalence between the total spaces
a section of the fibration B → A
explanation: A homotopy between dependent functions is Π(x:A). f(x) = g(x). Function extensionality (funext) says this implies f = g (they are equal as functions).
